dailyLog.meals: HIKE DAY, Devils Slide. 3:45am 2 slices bread. +1h 2 slices bread with peanut butter. Banana. 40 g bar. GU Roctane no caffeine. 2 GU Roctane with caffeine before the summit. At the summit a protein bar and another gel. Trail mix. Another gel at 9,000 ft. 4 oranges at 9,000 ft.
dailyLog.symptoms: Poor sleep. Incomplete bowel movement in two attempts before the 3:45am start. Mood dropped sharply the moment the gels ran out near the summit. GI event at 9,700 ft on descent requiring a stop. At 9,000 ft questioned whether to do Whitney at all and whether to stop training. Then finished the last three miles in 22, 21 and 23 minutes.
dailyLog.ownRead: Which means I had the energy but my mind didn't feel it, even the data shows.
